import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    b = int(next(it))
    arr = [int(next(it)) for _ in range(n)]

    dp = []
    odd = 0
    even = 0
    for i in range(n - 1):
        if arr[i] % 2 == 0:
            even += 1
        else:
            odd += 1
        if even == odd:
            dp.append(abs(arr[i+1] - arr[i]))

    dp.sort()
    # prefix sum in place
    for i in range(1, len(dp)):
        dp[i] += dp[i-1]

    l = 0
    for i in range(len(dp)):
        if dp[i] <= b:
            l = i + 1  # because i is 0-indexed, l is count of elements <= b (index+1)
    print(l)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
